lines.en: label utamaidgen:
scene utamaidgen
I decide to spend the night at the maid cafe and lose most of my savings to the bundle of joy in front of me.
lines.zh: 我决定在女仆咖啡厅消磨一晚，然后把大半积蓄都败在眼前这个活宝身上。

lines.en: Uta pulls out all the stops and easily coerces me into believing that I am the only man in the world who has ever mattered to her.
lines.zh: Uta 使出浑身解数，轻而易举就让我相信，我是这世上唯一对她重要的男人。

lines.en: It is all a lie. I am being used.
lines.zh: 这一切都是谎言。我在被利用。

lines.en: And yet, I am unable to fight off any of it.
lines.zh: 然而，我却一点都抵抗不了。

lines.en: I don't {i}want{/i} to fight off any of it.
The darkness swallows me.
All I know is Uta. All I can see is Uta.
lines.zh: 我只知道 Uta。我只看得见 Uta。

lines.en: All there will ever be is Uta.
She truly is a monster...and this place is Hell.
lines.zh: 她真是个怪物……而这里是地狱。

lines.en: scene black
After I come to terms with my meaningless existence and the perpetual struggle against all things cute, our conversation returns to normal.
lines.zh: 在我接受了自己毫无意义的存在、以及与一切可爱之物无休止的抗争之后，我们的对话回到了正轨。

lines.en: It's a mostly dead night inside of the cafe, so the two of us are able to spend a good amount of time together.
lines.zh: 今晚咖啡厅里基本没什么人，所以我们俩得以好好待上一阵。

lines.en: Apparently, an added benefit to being friends with Uta is the ability to bypass the hourly charges here.
lines.zh: 看来和 Uta 做朋友还有个附加好处：这里的按时计费对我无效。

lines.en: So, somehow or another, I manage to not wind up penniless when it finally comes time for me to leave.
lines.zh: 所以，不知怎么的，等我终于要离开的时候，竟没落得身无分文。

lines.en: Ami is going to be so proud of me.
lines.zh: Ami 一定会为我骄傲的。
